extracted.name: Non-alcoholic summer spritz
extracted.description: This non-alcoholic cocktail uses granadilla, a type of passion fruit which is both sweet and sour – it makes a fruity spritz with slight tartness.
ingredient_lines: ½ ripe granadilla passion fruit pulp only (see tip below)
instruction_lines: Tip the passion fruit pulp, lime juice and sugar syrup into a wine glass and gently muddle using a muddler or the end of a rolling pin.
Add the ice and sparkling water and stir before serving.
